items.label: 34 Pcs Kids Doctor Kit
items.value: Equip your child with essential medical tools , our kids doctor toy sets include a stethoscope that can make real heartbeats, blood pressure cuff, thermometer, oxygen bottle, syringe, bandages, and other diagnostic and treatment first aid essentials. Doctor kit for toddlers 3-5 also includes a doctor costume and a convenient tote bag for easy storage and portability, And assembled in a beautiful Gift Packaging Box.

items.label: Educational Kids Doctors Play Set
items.value: Foster your child's imagination, empathy, and bravery with the EFO SHM doctor set. This engaging pretend play set teaches children about medical tools and body parts, reducing anxiety and fear associated with doctor visits.

items.label: Safe and Durable Non-Toxic
items.value: Our doctor kit is made of durable ABS plastic,non-toxic and odorless. Toddler doctor kit is designed with smooth edges to provide a safe and reliable play experience for young children, and parents can rest assured that they can use our toddler doctor play sets for an enjoyable pretend play experience with their children.

items.label: Portable and Easy to Store
items.value: The toddler doctor playset for kids comes with a spacious storage bag, making it convenient for storage and travel purposes.Teach your child the importance of organizing and help cultivate children's awareness of storing toys.

items.label: Ideal Set for Toddlers
items.value: This kids doctor set is a perfect kit for various occasions such as parties, pretend play, role play, class rewards, holiday toys, stocking stuffers, and birthdays. Playing with the EFOSHM doctor set helps children learn about doctors and alleviates their fear of medical visits.

items.label: Educational Objective
items.value: Role Play, Imagination Development, Medical Knowledge, Empathy, and Bravery
